channel.description: Recent content in Projects on Cédric Van Huffelen

item.title: Volumetric Lighting
item.author: cedricvanhuffelen@gmail.com (Cédric Van Huffelen)
item.description: Volumetric light effects are caused by light being scattered in a humid or dusty environment. It’s a beautiful looking natural phenomenon also known as ‘god rays’.

item.title: Heightmap Blending
item.author: cedricvanhuffelen@gmail.com (Cédric Van Huffelen)
item.description: Texture blending techniques for shaders based on height textures for a more realistic result.

item.title: Realistic Wet Materials
item.author: cedricvanhuffelen@gmail.com (Cédric Van Huffelen)
item.description: Physically accurate wet-surface shading for PBR. Covers why wet materials look darker and shinier, and how to reproduce it in a shader.

item.title: Subsurface Scattering
item.author: cedricvanhuffelen@gmail.com (Cédric Van Huffelen)
item.description: Almost every material in the real world is slightly translucent, this means that light enters the material and is scattered around and then exits the surface.

item.title: GPU Driven Object Placement
item.author: cedricvanhuffelen@gmail.com (Cédric Van Huffelen)
item.description: Arbor is a GPU-driven object placement system for Unity, designed to place thousands of assets across large regions.
